title: BioPulse-QA: A Dynamic Biomedical Question-Answering Benchmark for Evaluating Factuality, Robustness, and Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Template-based counterfactual generation systematically swapping age descriptors (e.g., adult vs. pediatric) in original clinical questions while preserving context, and comparing model F1 score responses across these counterfactual pairs.
